title: Mouse holding a heart
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="22" ry="20" fill="#8a8fa8"/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="73" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#c9cbe0"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="#9a9fb8"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="26" r="10" fill="#9a9fb8"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="26" r="6" fill="#f2b6c8"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="26" r="10" fill="#9a9fb8"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="26" r="6" fill="#f2b6c8"/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="11" ry="8" fill="#d8daea"/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="3" fill="#ff7fa3"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="3" fill="#2b2f45"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="3" fill="#2b2f45"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="37" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="37" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1="38" y1="49" x2="26" y2="46" stroke="#c9cbe0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="38" y1="52" x2="26" y2="54" stroke="#c9cbe0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="49" x2="74" y2="46" stroke="#c9cbe0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="52" x2="74" y2="54" stroke="#c9cbe0" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- arms holding heart -->
  <ellipse cx="36" cy="62" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8a8fa8" transform="rotate(-20 36 62)"/>
  <ellipse cx="64" cy="62" rx="7" ry="5" fill="#8a8fa8" transform="rotate(20 64 62)"/>
  <!-- heart -->
  <path d="M50 74 C44 66 34 66 34 56 C34 50 40 48 44 51 C47 53 50 57 50 57 C50 57 53 53 56 51 C60 48 66 50 66 56 C66 66 56 66 50 74 Z" fill="#ff5f87"/>
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="55" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#ffb0c4"/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="90" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f2b6c8"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="90" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#f2b6c8"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M72 80 Q86 78 84 66" stroke="#f2b6c8" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
